name.zh: 切换快慢，控制跨越与落点
name.en: Switch speed to control reach and landing

summary.zh: 跑得快能跨远处，走得慢才容易对准窄路。
summary.en: Running reaches farther; walking makes narrow approaches easier to control.

rules.zh: 玩家能在较快和较慢的移动状态之间切换。快移动扩大横向跨越距离，却缩短接近危险时的反应时间；慢移动让边缘和窄落点更容易对准，玩家要在同一段路上反复改变速度。
rules.en: Switch between faster and slower movement. Speed extends horizontal reach but reduces reaction time near danger. Slower movement makes edges and narrow landings easier to align, so a single route calls for repeated speed changes.

loop.en: Cross the gap or narrow section
Change speed for the next obstacle

decisions.zh: 宽坑前要不要提速，还是先慢走到更靠近边缘的位置？
decisions.en: Build speed before a wide gap, or first walk closer to its edge?

decisions.zh: 落点附近有陷阱，继续跑能赶时间，但是否先切慢速确认安全？
decisions.en: Running saves time near a trapped landing, but should you slow down to verify the approach?

effect.zh: 差距越大，切换的价值越清楚，但窄路上误用快跑的代价也更大。
effect.en: A larger difference makes switching matter more, while increasing the cost of running on narrow paths.

effect.zh: 立即变化便于精确调整，缓慢变化则要求更早判断下一处障碍。
effect.en: Immediate changes support precise adjustment; gradual changes require reading the next obstacle earlier.

contrast.zh: 《超级食肉男孩》的快跑主要服务连续跨越挑战；《洞穴探险2》还要求玩家结合陷阱、可拾物和未知地形判断何时放慢。
contrast.en: Super Meat Boy uses running to support continuous traversal challenges; Spelunky 2 also asks players to slow down around traps, pickups and unfamiliar terrain.

combination.zh: 设计提案：随机拼接宽坑与带陷阱的窄路，入口先展示一小段前路，让玩家边观察边切换快慢，而非全程按住奔跑。
combination.en: Design proposal: recombine wide gaps and narrow trapped paths, showing a short preview from each entrance so players read ahead and adjust speed.

setup.zh: 教学示例：前半段是 4 格宽坑，落点后紧接一条 1 格宽的安全路。
setup.en: Teaching example: a four-tile gap is followed by a one-tile-wide safe approach.

action.zh: 你先跑跳过坑，接近落点时切换慢速。
action.en: Run and jump across the gap, then switch to slower movement as you approach the landing.

result.zh: 横向距离足够，落地后也没有继续冲向路边的危险。
result.en: You cover the distance and avoid rushing into the hazard beyond the landing.

next.zh: 下一处间隙更短，可以继续慢速通过，或为更远的支路重新加速。
next.en: The next gap is shorter: stay slow or accelerate toward a farther branch.

firstStep.zh: 制作一条 20 格长的测试路：宽坑、窄落点、贴边陷阱各一处，只提供跑走切换和跳跃。
firstStep.en: Build a twenty-tile route with one wide gap, one narrow landing and one edge hazard; provide only run/walk switching and jumping.

pitfall.zh: 如果快跑能无代价解决所有障碍，慢走按钮就没有选择价值。
pitfall.en: If running solves every obstacle without a tradeoff, walking has no decision value.

test.zh: 记录每段采用的速度；确认同一位玩家会主动在宽坑前提速、窄路前降速。
test.en: Record speed choices by section; check that the same player intentionally speeds up before the gap and slows before the narrow path.
